facts.fact: Lucy 直接断定 Daniel 是跟踪她的人，并且认为这不容置疑。
这张卡片用消失墨水写着 Lucy 的名字、日期和精确年龄。
facts.anchor: It’s as plain as the disappearing ink on this notecard. My name, the date, and my exact freaking age were there.

facts.fact: Lucy 猜卡片上涂了毒或酸一类的防护物，谁去读它指尖就会被烧掉，所以不能徒手碰。
facts.anchor: He must have put some kind of defensive poison or acid or something on the card so anyone who tries to read it gets their fingertips singed off.

facts.fact: 她决定把卡片交给警方，指望警方取指纹、做法证，并查出这个人去了哪里。
facts.anchor: I have to take this notecard to the police. They can take fingerprints, or do forensics, or something.

facts.fact: 她用下一张桌上绣着 Professor Shiran 首字母的布餐巾裹住手，像夹手雷一样拿起卡片。
facts.anchor: I wrap my hand in one of them and pick up the card like it’s a grenade.

facts.fact: 卡片掉进包里后又自己浮回餐巾纸上，她再摇一次仍然如此。
facts.anchor: Once again the card floats back up to the napkin like gravity is nothing but some cosmic joke to it.

facts.fact: 她扫了一圈人群找不到朋友 Eleanor，也不愿惊动教授们，认定唯一能求助的人是妹妹 Jess（护士训练，也能陪她去警局）。
facts.anchor: The only person I can turn to right now is Jess.

facts.fact: 结尾她站在路口低头等 Jess 的下一条短信，一辆巴士突然从不知何处冲了出来。
facts.anchor: Listen, that bus comes out of nowhere.
